abstracts.title: Lattice heating in thin films after optical excitation

titles: Lattice heating in thin films after optical excitation
Heat flow across a metal–semiconductor interface
descriptions: This study follows heat flow across an interface with time-resolved X-ray scattering. The other study uses the same scattering technique on thin films, so its procedure carries over directly, though it asks how fast a lattice heats rather than how heat crosses a boundary.

This study measures how fast a thin film's lattice heats after a laser pulse with time-resolved X-ray scattering. The other study uses the same scattering technique to follow heat across an interface, so its procedure and analysis carry over, though it asks how heat crosses a boundary rather than how fast a lattice heats.

methods.intent: A material's heat flow shows in how its atoms scatter X-rays over time.
methods.technique: Time-resolved X-ray scattering after a laser pulse heats one side of an interface.

methods.intent: How fast a crystal lattice heats shows in how its X-ray scattering changes after a pulse.
methods.technique: Time-resolved X-ray scattering of a thin film after optical heating.
